race.comment: LAZZURA (1) is probably the best Group 2/3 mare in the country and she finds a lovely race again. Sat just off the leaders then went home far too well in the Racing And Sports Golden Pendant over this trip at Rosehill four weeks ago. The wide barrier presents a challenge for Berry but with even luck she wins again. The danger could be IDLE FLYER (2) if she brings her A-game. Got within two lengths of Autumn Glow two back then was never on the track in the Epsom so forget that run. At her best she is Group 1 quality so do not rule her out. PERFUMIST (10) trounced them in the Tibbie first-up at Newcastle over today's distance then faded after racing on the speed in the Epsom, adding to a poor second-up record. In the right race to bounce back. VERONA ROSE (3) took a bit of ground off LAZZURA when they clashed four weeks ago. Draws perfectly but has never fired third-up which is the niggle. Nivison winner GERRINGONG (9) is yet to win in six 1400m runs but should be thereabouts.
